annotations.title: HMAC (SHA-256/384/512/1, MD5), e.g. to check a webhook signature

description: HMAC (SHA-256/384/512/1, MD5), e.g. to check a webhook signature. Computes HMAC of a message with a key (text, hex or base64). Optionally compares against an expected signature in constant time and reports whether it matches. Keys are not stored or logged. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).

expected.description: Optional signature to compare (hex or base64, optional "sha256=" prefix)
